title: Ranger specialty picks
caption: At level 19 with Snipe at skill level 8, the Ranger's Skills card now offers Snipe's specialty with the guide's pick.

title: A disputed specialty pick
caption: With Earth's Retribution at skill level 8, the Cleric's Skills card now leads with its specialty: the guide's pick, tagged disputed because sources split.

title: When no source names a pick
caption: Divine Aura's second specialty slot now says "no guide pick" instead of "Pick a specialty"; the tag's tooltip gives the reason.
